name: HWIDR Dumps API
description: Static JSON API exposing the Fortnite, Apex Legends and Valorant dumps published on the HWIDR SDK Viewer. Namespaced per game under api/<game>/.

endpoints.description: API metadata, games list and endpoint index (this file)
Fortnite offsets grouped by namespace, with raw Offsets.hpp
Fortnite decrypt constants grouped by file and namespace, with raw headers
Fortnite UFunctions grouped by class: {class: [{name, offset}]}
Fortnite SDK type index: {Classes, Structs, Enums} (names only)
Apex Legends dump: mics, buttons, recvTables, convars, stats
Valorant offsets grouped by namespace, with raw Offsets.hpp
Valorant decrypt constants grouped by file and namespace, with raw headers
Valorant UFunctions grouped by class: {class: [{name, offset}]}
Valorant SDK type index: {Classes, Structs, Enums} (names only)
Fortnite full SDK header sources {category/name: header}, split across 2 file(s): fetch api/fortnite/sdkContent.json.part0..1, JSON.parse each and merge
Valorant full SDK header sources {category/name: header}, split across part file(s): fetch api/valorant/sdkContent.json.part0..N, JSON.parse each and merge
